question: What does registration revision 3 specify that the pilot never used?

specified.note: 13 coefficients incl. c0 + deltas + delta-deltas, librosa, 25 ms window / 10 ms hop. Features with no learned structure.

Run in the span grid's pooled design (2026-10-29), on the 10,334 sites under joint: best layer 9 on every span, balanced accuracy 0.616–0.625. Ahead of MFCC on every span (C5). Index 0 is not the CNN output but LayerNorm(projection + positional conv), so it carries position (span grid §8).
Index 0 is the input to the first layer; 1–12 are layer outputs. Pretraining data not yet checked against the paper.

answer:
**One item: the facebook/wav2vec2-base representation** [rep-wav2vec2]. It is listed with an exploratory role, and its only recorded user is the span grid run, not the pilot [rep-wav2vec2].

wav2vec2 wasn't left unused overall. It was run in the span grid's pooled design on 2026-10-29, on the 10,334 sites under the joint condition [rep-wav2vec2, cond-joint]. There:

- The best layer was 9 on every span.
- Balanced accuracy ranged from 0.616 to 0.625.
- It scored above MFCC on every span (C5) [rep-wav2vec2, rep-mfcc].

The note adds that index 0 is not the CNN output but LayerNorm(projection + positional conv), so it carries position information [rep-wav2vec2].

Every other specified item lists the pilot among its users. That covers:

- the four conditions [cond-joint, cond-random, cond-speaker, cond-word]
- the word lookup baseline [ctrl-lookup]
- the [ɾ] environment [env-flap]
- the three poolings [pool-max, pool-mean, pool-midpoint]
- the linear probe [probe-linear]
- the MFCC and WavJEPA representations [rep-mfcc, rep-wavjepa]
- the control, speaker ID and voicing tasks [task-control, task-speaker, task-voicing]

All specified items are marked as used by at least one run, so nothing in the specification went entirely unused.

The rows don't say they come from revision 3 specifically. If revision 3 differs from what these rows reflect, they can't show that.
